review.rationale: Option A provides a rigorous, bounded multi-lane review structure that appropriately addresses the semantic, governance, and maintainability risks of a 100-file Draft PR. The four lanes (Execution/Workflow, Schema/Data Contract, Public/Developer Surface, Governance/Authority) plus a non-suppressing synthesis ensure comprehensive coverage without scope compression. The strict model contract (exact qwen3.7-max, no retry/fallback, direct JSON, 5-request cap) and FAIL_CLOSED policy on any transport/coverage failure enforce discipline. Full inventory coverage is preserved by requiring Lane D to receive the complete 100-file inventory. The synthesis explicitly prohibits silent deletion or downgrading of lane findings. No merge authority is granted—review results are confined to the governance branch with no GitHub review/comment submission. This aligns precisely with the agent-customer’s stance that R2 PASS and mergeable/clean status are necessary but insufficient for merge approval on a change set of this scale and complexity.
